system.text:
A player may choose to make his Dwarven character especially Greedy. With this trait, he can raise his character’s starting Greed to whatever exponent he desires (so long as it is higher than what it would start at). The downside of this is that Greed tests always count as the type of test the character needs to advance, no matter the obstacle. If he needs a routine, the next test counts as routine. See the Greed mechanics for the ramifications of this.

Type: Dt (die trait). Cost: 3 pts.

Restrictions: Dwarves only, special trait

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 314
